# A cost basis on a split the transaction values at nothing.
#
# The transaction is stated in Hong Kong dollars and moves US dollars, so no
# split of it is in the book's own currency and nothing in it says what those US
# dollars cost. The split says so itself with `cost_basis_cost:`. Its `value:`
# is 0.00 — the transaction prices it at nothing — so the price per unit the
# transaction gives is nothing, and the stated cost stands alone.
#
# What that settles: the itemized entry cannot divide the cost into a price and
# a rate, because there is no price to divide by. It states the cost as both, at
# a rate of 1.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_cost_basis_whose_split_is_valued_at_nothing.py.
